meaning:
1) to shut up, stop up
1a) (Niphal) to be stopped, be shut up
1b) (Piel) to shut up, give over

elsewhere.note: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.
But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.
I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord. A fierce king will rule over them,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.
